card.name: Start of drug brand names and anti-CD20
card.fires_on: The word 'anti' right before '-CD20' in biologic drug warnings, and the early pieces of brand names such as SIMPONI, ACTEMRA and KIMMTRAK. Also fires weakly on scattered ordinary words in news text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word continuations such as name endings, and away from absorption words.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of biologic drug names and the word 'anti' in anti-CD20, where the name is not yet finished.
